lessons.title: Lesson 1: Leisure activities vocabulary & Pronunciation /ʊ/ and /uː/
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Leisure activities vocabulary & Pronunciation /ʊ/ and /uː/.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: Verbs like like, love, hate, prefer can be followed by either a gerund (V-ing) or a to-infinitive (to V) with little difference in meaning.
concepts.example: I like making origami. / I like to make origami in my free time.
concepts.essence: V-ing emphasizes the enjoyment of the activity; To-infinitive emphasizes habit, choice, or duty.

rules.meaning: Certain verbs such as enjoy, fancy, adore, dislike, detest, mind can ONLY be followed by a gerund (V-ing), NEVER a to-infinitive.
rules.example: She fancies doing DIY projects. (NOT: She fancies to do...)
rules.essence: Memorizing the distinct verb categories prevents common grammatical errors.

workedExamples.prompt: Choose the correct form: 'My friends detest (surf) __________ the net when camping outdoors.'
steps: Step 1: Identify the main verb: 'detest' (meaning intensely dislike).
Step 2: 'Detest' belongs to the category of verbs followed strictly by a Gerund.
workedExamples.answer: My friends detest surfing the net when camping outdoors.

commonMistakes.mistake: Writing 'I enjoy to hang out with friends.'
commonMistakes.why: 'Enjoy' is always followed by a gerund: 'I enjoy hanging out with friends.'
